# ChartSeries

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Contains the name, values, and optional style for one chart series.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

## Constructors

```typescript
new ChartSeries(options?: ChartSeriesOptions)
```

## Properties

- [`color`](#color): Series colour.
- [`dataPoints`](#datapoints): Data points for this series.
- [`name`](#name): Series name/label (e.g., "Year Sales", "Product A", "Q1 Revenue") Used in legends and tooltips.
- [`style`](#style): Series-specific styling options.

### `color`

```typescript
color: Color
```

Series colour. Accepts a palette token or hex. A series the author gave no colour reads as `#4f46e5` and is drawn in its chart's own colour (`barColor`, `lineColor`, `areaColor`, `dotColor`, `lollipopColor`).

Example, from `industry-templates/healthcare/lab-report`:

```typescript
series.color = color;
```

Example, from `industry-templates/field-service-property/site-inspection-report`:

```typescript
series.color = ACCENT;
```

### `dataPoints`

```typescript
dataPoints: ChartDataPoint[]
```

Data points for this series. Each data point contains a label, value, and optional format string.

> A list you can change.

Example, from `code-recipes/comparison-charts/bar-chart`:

```typescript
s.dataPoints = points;
```

Example, from `industry-templates/compliance-audit/audit-report`:

```typescript
series.dataPoints = order.map((label, i) => {
  const p = new ChartDataPoint();
  p.label = label;
  p.value = counts[i];
  return p;
});
```

### `name`

```typescript
name: string
```

Series name/label (e.g., "Year Sales", "Product A", "Q1 Revenue") Used in legends and tooltips.

Example, from `code-recipes/share-ranking-charts/pie-chart`:

```typescript
series.name = 'Revenue';
```

Example, from `code-recipes/comparison-charts/grouped-bar-chart`:

```typescript
clothing.name = 'Clothing';
```

### `style`

```typescript
style: ChartSeriesStyle
```

Series-specific styling options. Allows customization of line width, opacity, marker size, etc.
